パンを焼くとなぜ茶色く、おいしくなる？――熱が新しい香りを作る化学

A Japanese-English mixed explanation of why bread browns and develops its characteristic aroma during baking. It connects heat and moisture transport to crust formation, then follows reducing sugars and amino compounds into the Maillard reaction network, aroma compounds, melanoidins, caramelization, and acrylamide.
